title: 「Far from + 形容詞」表示「遠未／絕非」
titleZh: 「Far from + 形容詞」表示「遠未／絕非」
titleEn: Using far from + adjective to express a large gap from a standard

source.file: Sentence Structure 115 - 「Far from + 形容詞」表示「遠未／絕非」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + be + far from + adjective + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + be + far from + adjective + other information

example: The work is far from complete.

examples.en: The work is far from complete.
Mary’s performance was far from satisfactory.
examples.zh: 瑪麗的表現遠未令人滿意。

rules.zh: “Far from + adjective”表示程度上相差很遠 它表示某人或某事物完全未達到形容詞所描述的狀態，意思接近： ● 完全不…… ● 遠未…… ● 絕非…… ● 離……還差很遠 第二句的語氣較強，表示不但尚未完成，而且距離完成仍有一段很大的距離。
rules.en: “Far from + adjective” expresses a large difference in degree. It means that a person or thing is not at all, nowhere near or not even close to the state described by the adjective. The second sentence is stronger: it says not only that the work is unfinished, but that a considerable amount remains before completion.
examples: The work is far from complete.

rules.zh: “Far from”後面須使用形容詞 在本課中，學生應直接把形容詞放在 far from 後面。
rules.en: Use an adjective after far from in this target pattern. In this lesson, students should place the adjective directly after far from.

rules.zh: Be動詞須配合主語和時態
rules.en: Match the form of be to the subject and tense.
examples: The plan is far from perfect.
The journey was far from smooth.
The figures are far from accurate.

rules.zh: 負面形容詞要理解整個意思 如果後面的形容詞本身帶有負面意思，便要理解整個詞組，而不是逐字翻譯。
rules.en: Interpret the whole phrase carefully when the adjective is already negative. In that case, far from means that the negative description is not true, rather than carrying a literal word-for-word meaning.
examples: The machine is far from useless.
The task is far from impossible.

rules.zh: 不要與表示實際距離的“far from”混淆 這裏的 far from 表示實際距離，後面接名詞，並非本課練習的句型。
rules.en: Do not confuse this pattern with far from used for physical distance. In the physical-distance use, far from is followed by a noun phrase and is not the target structure in this exercise.
examples: The school is far from my home.

rules.zh: 本課不使用“far from + -ing” 這是另一個文法結構，意思是「不但沒有……，反而……」，不屬於本課範圍。
rules.en: Far from + -ing is a separate grammatical structure meaning ‘not only did something not happen; the opposite happened instead’, and it is outside the scope of this lesson.
examples: Far from helping us, the change created more problems.

benefits.zh: 能清楚表示「距離目標仍很遠」 這個句型不只是表示某事「不是」完整、安全或成功，而是清楚指出實際情況與理想標準仍有很大 距離。
benefits.en: It shows a large difference clearly. This structure does more than say that something is ‘not’ complete, safe or successful. It tells the reader that the actual situation is still very different from the expected standard.

benefits.zh: 能以較冷靜而有力的方式提出批評 使用 far from satisfactory 可以清楚表達不滿，同時令語氣較有控制，適合用於作文、報告、投 訴信和商業溝通。
benefits.en: It helps you express criticism firmly but calmly. Instead of using emotional words such as terrible, you can make a controlled evaluation. Far from satisfactory expresses dissatisfaction clearly while keeping the tone controlled, making it suitable for essays, reports, complaint letters and business communication.

benefits.zh: 能令評價更加準確 這個句型可以準確評價品質、進度、準備程度、安全程度、確定性和成效。
benefits.en: It makes evaluations more precise. You can use the structure to evaluate quality, progress, preparation, safety, certainty and success.

benefits.zh: 能避免重複使用簡單否定句 你可以利用這個句型改變表達方式，避免連續使用相同的否定結構，令說話和寫作更有句式變 化。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to express strong negative meaning. Instead of repeatedly using not very, not at all or not nearly, you can use far from + adjective, adding variety to speech and writing.

benefits.zh: 適合用於作文、報告和簡報 當你要分析一個計劃、結果、制度或情況是否達到預期標準時，這個句型非常實用。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, reports and presentations. The structure is especially useful when discussing whether a plan, result, system or situation has reached an expected standard.
